messages:
Maya (oncall): @incidentbot didn't page me for the urgent prod alert at ~22:16 UTC. Customers opening tickets now, is pager infra up?
incidentbot: FAILEDDELIVERY to +1*** for oncall 'maya' - HTTP 502 from https://pager.internal/api/push (attempts=3)
Alice (sre): I'm seeing 502 and 403 in `pager-proxy` logs around 21:50-22:20. Could be auth token mismatch.
Ben (support): customer reports 'no page, no call' window ~22:16-22:31. Ticket #CS-842 created.
Julian (eng): grabbing logs and secret state. Which k8s secret backs the incidentbot webhook?
ops-sre: it's `pager-webhook-token` mounted into `incidentbot` and `pager-proxy`. Rotation job ran ~21:50 UTC (today).
incidentbot: webhook auth check failed: signature validation error - token mismatch.
Julian (eng): confirmed: secret rotated but proxy cache still holds old credential. Planning to restart proxy and purge cache.
Maya (oncall): manual pages placed (phone) to the 3 impacted customer orgs while we fix.
Julian (eng): executing restart now: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/pager-proxy` then purge cache: `curl -XPOST https://pager.internal/cache/purge -H 'Authorization: Bearer <admin>'`
Alice (sre): restart finished, new pods Ready 3/3. Proxy logs show successful handshake with webhook.
incidentbot: RETRYDELIVERY successes=12 failures=0 (queued messages retried)
Ben (support): CS confirms customers received pages/calls at 22:31 UTC, they acknowledged. No P1 escalation from customers.
Maya (oncall): Interim mitigation success. Impact summary: 3 paying customer orgs affected, ~15m delayed paging, no data exposure. Filing follow-up.
Julian (eng): created JIRA INC-8942. Root cause: secret rotation + cache invalidation race between `pager-proxy` and rotation job. Proposed fixes: rotation job must POST cache purge + add delivery health-checks to alert on 5xx.
Maya (oncall): assigning postmortem to Julian. @Customer Success (Leah) please prepare customer note for tomorrow.
Customer Success (Leah): will draft a short, empathetic notice and share with ops for review.
Maya (oncall): adding this thread to the incident timeline. Closing live coordination — reopen if follow-up needed. :white_check_mark:
